name: Sister Jane

valance-spot-maxi-dress.d: For the grandest of entrances. The Valance Spot Maxi Dress combines delicate floral lace with flocked velvet polka dots, creating a rich, textured finish across the romantic silhouette. A tiered skirt and cascading ruffle trims add movement and drama, making it the perfect evening dress for galas, weddings, candlelit dinners and special occasions. Style with heels and statement jewellery for an unforgettable occasion look.

mirage-velvet-jacket.d: A little extravagance for cooler evenings. The Mirage Velvet Jacket combines rich velvet with shimmering sequin embellishment, a luxurious faux fur lining and statement beaded frog buttons for an unmistakably glamorous finish. The perfect evening jacket for parties, dinners and special occasions, pair with the Mirage Velvet Trousers for a complete after-dark velvet statement, or style over a simple dress for instant occasion glamour.

joan-spot-bow-blouse.d: The Joan Spot Bow Blouse brings a touch of sparkle to everyday dressing. Designed in shimmering Lurex with a classic polka dot pattern, this statement blouse is finished with an oversized adjustable necktie for a romantic flourish. Pair with the Mirage Velvet Trousers for a rich mix of sparkle, velvet and print, or style with tailored trousers or denim for an elevated day-to-evening look.

joan-spot-fringe-scarf.d: A little sparkle makes every outfit feel more like an occasion. The Joan Spot Fringe Scarf is crafted in shimmering Lurex with a playful polka dot pattern and finished with delicate fringing along the edges. Perfect for parties, dinners and festive evenings, drape it loosely around the neck or wear over your shoulders as an elegant finishing layer. Pair with velvet, satin or simple black tailoring for added glamour.

mirage-velvet-trousers.d: Rich, indulgent and designed to catch the light, the Mirage Velvet Trousers bring evening glamour to tailored dressing. Sumptuous velvet is finished with shimmering sequin embellishment, adding unexpected sparkle to the classic straight-leg silhouette. Perfect for parties, dinners and festive occasions, pair with the Joan Spot Bow Blouse for a glamorous evening look, or style with a simple top and heels for an effortless night-out ensemble.

joan-spot-midi-dress.d: Polka dots take on a more decadent mood in the Joan Spot Midi Dress. Crafted with shimmering Lurex, this statement dress catches the light with every movement, while an open back, adjustable necktie and tiers of ruffles create a romantic, flowing silhouette. Perfect for weddings, parties, lunches and special occasions, style with heels and statement earrings for a look that transitions effortlessly from day to evening.

rendez-vous-lame-blouse.d: A little golden glamour goes a long way. The Rendez-vous Lamé Blouse brings luminous texture to occasion dressing with shimmering lamé, a statement beaded collar, black dome buttons and an adjustable necktie. Perfect for parties, dinners and festive occasions, pair with the Mirage Velvet Trousers for an opulent contrast of gold and rich velvet, or style with tailored trousers or denim for an elevated day-to-evening look.

rendez-vous-lame-bow-maxi-dress.d: Make every rendez-vous feel like an occasion in the Rendez-vous Lamé Bow Maxi Dress. Designed in shimmering gold lamé, this statement maxi dress brings glamour to parties, weddings, cocktail evenings and special occasions. An adjustable necktie and gathered skirt create a flattering silhouette with elegant movement. Pair with strappy heels and statement earrings for an effortlessly glamorous evening look.

alexis-jacquard-jacket.d: The Alexis Jacquard Jacket brings a little old-world glamour to party-season dressing. Crafted in rich floral jacquard, this regular-fit jacket is finished with contrast braided rope trim and statement pearl buttons for an elegant, decorative touch. Style with the Alexis Jacquard Mini Dress for a coordinated occasion look, or layer over tailored trousers and a simple top for an effortlessly polished evening outfit.

rumour-satin-bow-blouse.d: The Rumour Satin Bow Blouse brings romantic glamour to occasion dressing. Crafted in luxurious satin jacquard, this statement blouse features layered flounce cuffs, a dramatic necktie and delicate black heart buttons for an elevated finish. Perfect for parties, dinners and evening occasions, pair with the Tyler Velvet Trousers for a sophisticated look, or style with tailored trousers or denim for versatile day-to-night dressing.

alexis-jacquard-bag.d: A little treasure to carry from one escapade to the next. The Alexis Jacquard Bag combines rich floral jacquard with velvet piping and a playful tassel trim, making it feel like a keepsake collected on a particularly glamorous adventure. The perfect finishing touch for party season, pair with the Alexis Jacquard Mini Dress for a beautifully coordinated floral moment, or let it add a touch of occasion glamour to a simple evening look.

alexis-jacquard-mini-dress.d: The Alexis Jacquard Mini Dress was made for a grand entrance. Rich floral jacquard is framed by chevron fringing at the hem, bringing movement, texture and a little extra drama to a beautifully fitted silhouette. The perfect evening mini dress with a twist, style with heels and statement jewellery for your next party, or pair with the Alexis Jacquard Bag for a complete floral jacquard moment.

heiress-tassel-mini-dress.d: The Heiress Tassel Mini Dress has a certain inherited glamour about it, even if the invitation arrived this morning. A sleek crepe silhouette is finished with a high neckline and statement tassel trims, creating a look that feels rich, playful and perfectly at home after dark. Style with pointed heels and statement earrings for cocktail hour, evening dinners or a night on the town.

limelight-sequin-maxi-dress.d: Take your place in the limelight. The Limelight Sequin Maxi Dress combines an all-over sequin bodice with an asymmetric tulle skirt, creating a dramatic silhouette designed to catch the light and command attention. Made for galas, champagne receptions and nights worth dressing up for, style with barely-there heels and statement earrings for a head-turning occasion look.

dynasty-check-jacket.d: Tailoring takes a turn for the extravagant. The Dynasty Check Jacket combines a bold check with shimmering gold sequin trim and statement gem buttons, bringing a little gala glamour to classic tailoring. Pair with the Dynasty Check Trousers for a complete look worthy of a grand entrance, or style over a simple dress or denim. Your go-to look for taking you from the daytime office straight to drinks with the girls.

veronica-lace-blouse.d: Delicate lace meets unapologetic glamour in the Veronica Lace Blouse. Romantic ruffle detailing and statement gem buttons bring a jewellery-box extravagance to the elegant silhouette, making it a standout for both day and evening dressing. Pair with the Dynasty Check Trousers for an unexpected clash of delicate lace and bold tailoring, or style with denim and ballet flats for a more effortless everyday look.

dynasty-check-trousers.d: For the art of dressing up without taking yourself too seriously. The Dynasty Check Trousers bring bold checks and elegant tailoring together, with pleat detailing and a high-waisted silhouette creating a polished, confident finish. Pair with the Veronica Lace Blouse for a playful contrast of structured tailoring and romance, or style with a simple knit and loafers for an effortlessly chic daytime look.

veronica-lace-maxi-dress.d: Romance, with a touch of drama. The Veronica Lace Maxi Dress sweeps into the room with delicate floral lace, a statement cape collar and cascading ruffle details, creating a silhouette worthy of the grandest occasion. Made for candlelit dinners, champagne receptions and evenings that call for something unforgettable. Style with delicate heels and pearl jewellery for timeless elegance, or add statement earrings for a little extra drama.

legacy-jacquard-mini-dress.d: The Legacy Jacquard Mini Dress feels like something discovered in the wardrobe of a particularly glamorous woman with excellent taste. Rich floral jacquard, statement gem buttons and a grown-on necktie create an extravagant yet effortlessly composed silhouette. Perfect for afternoon escapades or evening affairs, style with ballet flats or knee-high boots by day, then switch to heels and statement jewellery for after-dark plans.

krystle-taffeta-ruffle-top.d: More is more in the Krystle Taffeta Ruffle Top. A flattering sweetheart neckline, sculpted peplum shape and statement shoulder ruffles create an unapologetically dramatic silhouette made for making an entrance. Pair with the Krystle Taffeta Ruffle Skirt for a full taffeta moment, perfect for parties and special occasions, or style with sleek tailored trousers to let the ruffles take centre stage.

krystle-taffeta-ruffle-skirt.d: Designed for entrances, twirls and occasions worth remembering. The Krystle Taffeta Ruffle Skirt wraps around the silhouette with a dramatic ruffle, bringing statement volume and movement to every step. Pair with the Krystle Taffeta Ruffle Top for a head-to-toe taffeta statement, perfect for parties and evening occasions, or style with a simple blouse and heels for a more understated take on the drama.

bianca-bow-blouse.d: The Bianca Bow Blouse brings a little theatre to polished dressing. An adjustable necktie, flounced cuffs and lustrous pearl buttons create a romantic silhouette with a beautifully collected feel. Pair with the Krystle Taffeta Ruffle Skirt for a full look of lavish bows and movement, perfect for parties, evening dinners and occasions that call for a little extra glamour. Or style with tailored trousers or denim for a more effortless take.

estate-jacquard-mini-dress.d: A dress for collecting stories in. The Estate Jacquard Mini Dress combines rich floral jacquard with a graceful keyhole neckline and removable embellished bows, creating a look that feels romantic, playful and wonderfully extravagant. Perfect for taking you from day to evening, style with ballet flats or boots for daytime plans, then switch to heels and statement jewellery when the evening begins.

cyndi-spot-jacquard-top.d: A playful take on the timeless spot, the Cyndi Spot Jacquard Top brings a little Parisian-style drama to everyday dressing. Woven in a tactile jacquard and finished with a fixed satin bow, it adds a polished flourish to even the simplest plans. Pair with the Colby Barrel Jeans for an effortless mix of glamour and ease, or style with tailored trousers and heels for an elevated evening look.

lise-organza-cami-top.d: Light as air and made for lingering evenings, the Lise Organza Cami Top brings romance to the simplest silhouette. A statement bow at the back and delicate pearl beading along the neckline add an indulgent finish, perfect for adding a touch of occasion to any look. Pair with the Colby Barrel Jeans for an effortlessly glamorous contrast, or style with tailored trousers and heels for evening plans.

maxwell-denim-mini-dress.d: Even denim deserves an invitation to the gala. The Maxwell Denim Mini Dress takes everyday ease somewhere more unexpected, with a relaxed silhouette elevated by intricate beaded trims tracing the neckline and hem. Made to take you from daytime plans to evening occasions, style with sneakers or ballet flats for a casual stroll, then swap for a kitten heel and statement earrings when the sun goes down.

parkside-jacquard-mini-dress.d: Let the fabric set the mood. The Parkside Jacquard Mini Dress is woven with a metallic floral pattern that catches the light with every movement, finished with a flounced hem for a touch of theatrical romance. Made for evenings when simply arriving isn’t quite enough. Style with strappy stilettos and delicate jewellery for a party-ready look, or add knee-high boots and a tailored coat for a more polished, fashion-forward finish.

bianca-bow-mini-dress.d: A bow, a little satin and plenty of occasion. The Bianca Bow Mini Dress brings playful elegance to the party with a pleated neckline, romantic puff sleeves and a statement bow cascading across the back. Designed for soirées, celebrations and every excuse to dress up, pair with heels and let the details do the talking.

krystle-jacquard-ruffle-mini-dress.d: The Krystle Jacquard Ruffle Mini Dress was made for making an entrance. Tonal jacquard meets a dramatic wrap around ruffle and unexpected open back, creating a silhouette that feels effortless and easy to wear. Our take on the little black dress, it's the perfect piece for an girls night out. Pair with your go to party heels and the purse and get ready for an unforgettable evening.

palm-velvet-mini-dress.d: A little velvet goes a long way. The Palm Velvet Mini Dress is rich in texture and romantic in silhouette, with gathered detailing, delicate butterfly sleeves and covered buttons creating a sense of timeless glamour. Made for evenings where the dress becomes part of the story, it’s the perfect choice for festive celebrations, candlelit dinners and everything in between. Style yours with knee-high boots for a cool seasonal finish or pair with classic stilettos for a touch of effortless elegance.

manor-jacquard-midi-dress.d: Romance takes centre stage in the Manor Jacquard Midi Dress. Rich floral jacquard, sculpted puff sleeves and a diamond-shaped open back create a dramatic silhouette. Wear for elegant lunches, candlelit dinners and evenings that turn into stories. Style with your favourite kitten heels for an evening or dinner, and with your ballet flats for a day time look.

denver-jacquard-midi-dress.d: The Denver Jacquard Midi Dress brings a bit of old world glamour into your modern wardrobe. Tonal jacquard, layered flounce cuffs and statement gem buttons create a polished silhouette with just the right amount of extravagance, finished with a removable embellished collar for a change of mood. Our top pick for any christmas party you might be attending for festive season.

samantha-sequin-mini-dress.d: Some occasions call for subtlety; others call for sequins. The Samantha Sequin Mini Dress embraces the latter, with multicoloured embellishment and a playful flounced hem designed to catch the light from every angle. A dress made for dancing and making an entrance.

heather-sequin-fringe-top.d: Fringe Top is cut in airy organza and finished with cascading sequin trims that shimmer with every movement, revealing an unexpected open back. The perfect piece to dress both up and down. Style with our Samantha Sequin Mini Skirt for a full spotlight moment or dress it down for more casual dinner with a pair of denim.

denver-fitted-top.d: A little embellishment can turn an ordinary moment into an occasion. The Denver Fitted Top combines a sculpted silhouette and dramatic puff sleeves with a removable embellished collar and jewel-like statement buttons. Pair with the Samantha Sequin Mini Skirt for an after-dark look with plenty of sparkle. Style the outfit with your favourite stilettos for an evening to remember.

samantha-sequin-top.d: The Samantha Sequin Top is made for collecting compliments. A kaleidoscope of multicoloured sequins brings the glamour, while the cropped silhouette keeps the mood playful and perfectly poised. Match with the Samantha Sequin Mini Skirt for a full sequin soirée. This is the perfect outfit for any special occasion coming up this party season.

starlet-velvet-maxi-dress.d: For evenings that deserve their own story, the Starlet Velvet Maxi Dress makes an entrance. Embellished velvet meets a voluminous organza skirt and romantic ruffles, creating a grand silhouette . A dress made for candlelit dinners, late night galas and lingering looks. Pair with a pair of boots for a casual day time look and swap for your kitten heels going into the evening.

cyndi-spot-jacquard-mini-dress.d: A little drama and a lot of decadence. The Cyndi Spot Jacquard Mini Dress brings a playful glamour to every occasion, with its statement fur trims, intricate pankou closures and timeless spot jacquard. Perfect for an cocktail evening with the girlfriends. Pair with the Cyndi Spot Jacquard Bag for a full spotlight moment.

divina-jacquard-maxi-dress.d: For evenings when you want to leave a little mystery behind. The Divina Jacquard Maxi Dress glows in metallic floral jacquard, with a high neckline, flowing tiers and long sleeves creating an elegant silhouette that feels almost otherworldly.

circe-sequin-lace-maxi-dress.t: DREAM Circe Sequin Lace Maxi Dress
circe-sequin-lace-maxi-dress.n: DREAM Circe Sequin Lace Maxi Dress
circe-sequin-lace-maxi-dress.d: A little spellbinding, just as the name suggests. The Circe Sequin Lace Maxi Dress shimmers with sequined lace, flowing into a full skirt framed by romantic ruffles and wide sleeves.

thalassa-ruffle-mini-dress.d: The kind of dress that feels like good news. Pintuck detailing, a gathered skirt and layered ruffles create a playful silhouette, while black gem and pearl buttons add a touch of vintage intrigue.

cosmo-jewel-midi-dress.d: A floral dream with a sparkling secret. The Cosmo Midi Dress is crafted in tonal floral jacquard and finished with colourful gem embellishments, while puff sleeves bring a playful sense of drama. Pair with the Cosmo Jewel Bag for a matching finish scattered with colourful little treasures.

peridot-jacquard-mini-dress.d: A little floral fortune in miniature. The Peridot Jacquard Mini Dress brings metallic jacquard to a playful silhouette, with ruffled details at the waist and hem adding plenty of movement. Pair with the Pheonix Velvet Grab Bag for an unexpected mix of floral jacquard and rich velvet.

pheonix-velvet-maxi-dress.d: A midnight dream in rich crushed velvet. The Pheonix Velvet Maxi Dress is finished with a high neckline, elegant sleeves and delicate pearl flower trims that bloom around the waist. Pair with the Pheonix Velvet Grab Bag to complete the look with matching velvet, pearls and a touch of vintage glamour.

elixir-ruffle-midi-dress.d: A little unexpected, just as a good fortune should be. The Elixir Ruffle Midi Dress has a silhouette that feels polished with a rebellious twist. Perfect for mysterious fall evenings when you don't know what to wear.

eclipse-jacquard-midi-dress.d: Made for moments when all eyes are on you. The Eclipse Jacquard Midi Dress combines textured jacquard with oversized disc embellishments, creating a striking silhouette with a celestial sense of drama.

echo-sequin-floral-maxi-dress.t: DREAM Echo Sequin Floral Maxi Dress
echo-sequin-floral-maxi-dress.n: DREAM Echo Sequin Floral Maxi Dress
echo-sequin-floral-maxi-dress.d: A floral dream with a little after-dark magic. The Echo Sequin Floral Maxi Dress is covered in shimmering sequins, while delicate tulle godets create movement through the sweeping silhouette.

moonstone-tweed-mini-dress.d: A modern little treasure with a touch of old-world charm. Soft tweed meets delicate organza shoulder ties and luminous pearl buttons, giving the Moonstone Tweed Mini Dress an effortlessly enchanting feel.

belladonna-organza-maxi-dress.d: A dress with an air of mystery, as though it has just stepped out of an enchanted evening. Structured organza, cascading ruffles and a sculptural bow give the Belladonna Organza Maxi Dress a wonderfully dramatic finish.

amythest-floral-jacquard-maxi-dress.t: DREAM Amethyst Floral Jacquard Maxi Dress
amythest-floral-jacquard-maxi-dress.n: DREAM Amethyst Floral Jacquard Maxi Dress
amythest-floral-jacquard-maxi-dress.d: A little shimmer, a little mystery, and florals that seem to have a story of their own. The Amethyst Floral Jacquard Maxi Dress catches the light in metallic jacquard, while puff sleeves and softly gathered ruffle tiers create a romantic silhouette made for memorable moments.

spellbound-velvet-maxi-dress.d: The Spellbound Velvet Maxi Dress is the ultimate midnight moment, crafted in rich crushed velvet with a softly ruched waist and decorative buttons. A high neck and voluminous sleeves create a dramatic silhouette that feels made for mysterious evenings beneath a star-filled sky.

fortunes-jacquard-midi-dress.d: The stars may not reveal everything, but the Fortunes Jacquard Midi Dress certainly makes an impression. Metallic floral jacquard catches the light beautifully, while decorative mixed buttons add the feeling of a treasured vintage discovery.

halo-ruffle-mini-dress.d: The Halo Ruffle Mini Dress surrounds you in soft layers of chiffon, with a tiered skirt and delicate ruffles creating an ethereal silhouette. The adjustable back tie adds a final touch of versatility to this dreamy little number, perfect for evenings under the stars.

charmed-jacquard-mini-dress.d: The Charmed Jacquard Mini Dress brings a little mystery to the mini silhouette with rich leopard jacquard and playful puff sleeves. Decorative mixed buttons add a vintage-inspired flourish, making this the kind of dress destined to become a favourite.

whisper-lace-trim-mini-dress.d: The Whisper lace Trim Mini Dress tells its own quiet story through soft texture and delicate lace ruffles, creating a mini dress that feels effortlessly romantic. From its gathered neckline to its elasticated cuffs, every detail adds to its charmingly mysterious mood.

hier-tassel-shirt.d: The Hier Tassel Shirt brings a touch of eccentric charm to classic shirting. Statement tassel trims frame the collar, adding movement and a theatrical finish to the structured silhouette. Designed for parties, cocktails and evening occasions, pair with the Preston Gem Trousers for a polished statement look with plenty of personality, or style with tailored trousers or denim for an elevated everyday outfit.

carrington-lace-bow-shirt.d: Romantic lace meets a little rebellion in the Carrington Lace Bow Shirt. Floral lace is scattered with flocked velvet polka dots and finished with a removable necktie and ruffled cuffs, creating an irresistibly collected feel. Pair with the Colby Barrel Jeans for an effortless mix of romance and everyday cool.

dex-ruffle-stripe-shirt.d: Classic shirting gets a romantic twist. The Dex Ruffle Stripe Shirt combines crisp stripes with diagonal pintucks and delicate ruffle detailing, creating a polished silhouette with plenty of personality. Perfect for taking you from desk to dinner, pair with the Tyler Velvet Trousers for an elegant mix of texture and tailoring, or style with denim and loafers for a more relaxed daytime look.

colby-denim-shirt.d: The Colby Denim Shirt proves everyday dressing can still have a little sparkle. Structured denim is scattered with delicate diamantes, bringing an unexpected jewel-like finish to a relaxed silhouette. Pair with a simple white T-shirt and the Colby Barrel Jeans for a statement denim-on-denim moment, or style with tailored trousers and heels for an elevated take on evening dressing.

sable-brooch-shirt.d: A classic shirt, collected with a connoisseur’s eye. The Sable Brooch Shirt is elevated with statement rope trim, mixed-button embellishment and gold ball buttons, bringing a sense of dressed-up eccentricity to polished dressing. Pair with the Tyler Velvet Trousers for a rich, textural evening look, or style with denim for an effortless office-to-evening outfit with a little extra sparkle.

demi-tulle-t-shirt.d: Everyday dressing, with a little excess. The Demi Tulle T-Shirt layers a soft, easy silhouette with delicate tulle and all-over bead embellishment, proving that even casual moments deserve their own kind of glamour. Pair with the Colby Barrel Jeans for an effortless dressed-up denim look, or style with a tailored trouser and kitten heels when the occasion calls for something a little more elevated.

fallon-tassel-shirt.d: For the connoisseur of the unexpected, the Fallon Tassel Shirt brings movement and party-ready glamour to classic shirting. Contrasting tassel embellishments add playful texture to the polished silhouette, made to turn heads from dinner to the dance floor. Pair with the Preston Gem Trousers for an elevated occasion look, or style with denim for an effortlessly dressed-up finish.

grant-bow-shirt.d: Consider this your invitation to dress the part. The Grant Bow Shirt pairs tonal stripes with a removable necktie and delicate contrast piping, bringing a touch of polished eccentricity to everyday dressing. Style with the Preston Gem Trousers for an elevated look that takes you from the office to evening plans, or pair with your go-to denim for a more relaxed take on tailored dressing.

mirage-spot-ruffle-top.d: A little twist on the expected. The Mirage Spot Ruffle Top plays with an asymmetric silhouette, playful polka dots and layered lace-trimmed ruffles for a look that feels romantic with a mischievous edge. Pair with the Orion Leopard Mini Skirt for an unexpected mix of spots, ruffles and wild print.

cosmo-jewel-shirt.d: A little sparkle can change everything. The Cosmo Shirt keeps its relaxed shape effortless, while colourful gem trims bring an unexpected flash of glamour to the placket. Pair with the Orion Leopard Mini Skirt for a playful mix of colour, sparkle and wild print.

thalassa-ruffle-blouse.d: A little romance with a playful twist. The Thalassa Blouse combines delicate pintuck detailing with a dramatic layered ruffle hem, finished with jewel-like buttons for an extra flash of charm. Pair with the Lazuli Embellished Jeans for an everyday magical look.

paradox-leopard-ruched-top.d: A little wild, a little unexpected. The Paradox Top combines playful leopard chiffon with gathered details and an adjustable hem, creating a relaxed silhouette with plenty of attitude. Pair with the Lazuli Embellished Jeans for a clash of leopard print and shimmering floral embellishment.

nova-tulle-cropped-top.d: A little top with plenty of charm. The Nova Tulle Cropped Top brings delicate texture to the look with its floral fabric and high neckline, creating an effortlessly polished silhouette. Pair with the Nova Tulle Midi Skirt to let the full floral story unfold.

elara-stud-embellished-blouse.d: Golden details give this softly tailored blouse its own little spell. The Elara Blouse combines a relaxed silhouette with delicate stud embellishments and a versatile waist tie that can be styled your way. Pair with the Elara Stud Embellished Circle Skirt for a head-to-toe look that feels like the stars have perfectly aligned.

fortunes-jacquard-jacket.d: The Fortunes Jacquard Jacket is a treasure in its own right, shimmering in metallic floral jacquard and finished with contrast piping and decorative gem buttons. Its cropped silhouette gives classic double-breasted tailoring a playful Sister Jane twist. Pair with the Fortunes Jacquard Trousers for a head-to-toe look destined for a night of fortune and mystery.

velora-ruffle-top.d: The Velora Ruffle Top feels like a whisper from another world, with soft chiffon falling into romantic ruffles at the neckline and cuffs. An elasticated waist gives the relaxed silhouette gentle definition, while concealed buttons keep the finish beautifully polished. Pair with the Fortunes Jacquard Trousers for a rich, textural look made for following your fortune.

celeste-floral-top.d: The Celeste Floral Top feels like a secret garden in bloom, with delicate chiffon, scalloped edging and charming frog closures. Its cropped silhouette makes it an easy piece for layering into your everyday wardrobe. Pair with the Celeste Frog Trim Jeans for a playful head-to-toe look with a little floral fortune.

whisper-lace-trim-top.d: Softly spellbound, the Whisper Lace Trim Top brings a little romance to everyday dressing with delicate lace ruffles framing the neckline, hem and cuffs. Its relaxed silhouette makes it wonderfully easy to wear while still feeling full of Sister Jane magic. Pair with the Celeste Frog Trim Jeans for an enchanting day-to-evening look with a cool denim edge.

tarot-reader-blouse.d: The cards are on the table with the Tarot Reader Blouse, adorned in Sister Jane’s mystical tarot print and framed by pleated ruffles. A removable ruffle bow adds an extra flourish, while pearl buttons bring a soft glimmer to this spellbinding style. Pair with the Celeste Frog Trim Jeans for a look where fortune-telling romance meets cool everyday denim.

endora-cape-blouse.d: The Endora Cape Blouse feels like a secret discovered in an enchanted wardrobe, with a removable cape collar finished in delicate lace. Statement gold gem buttons add a glimmer of treasure, making this blouse perfect for moments that call for a little extra magic. Pair with the Fates Check Ruffle Skirt for a romantic day to evening look layered with ruffles and intrigue.

destiny-spot-bow-blouse.d: A little fate, a little fortune, the Destiny Spot Bow Blouse is crafted in velvet spot chiffon and finished with a romantic neck tie. Velvet ribbon and covered buttons add an old-world charm, making this the perfect piece for dressing under a midnight sky. Pair with the Libra Stripe Denim Jeans for an enchanting contrast of delicate chiffon and everyday denim.

aura-lace-bow-blouse.d: Delicate lace meets romance in the Aura Lace Bow Blouse, finished with a grown-on neck tie and shimmering gold buttons. It has the feeling of a treasured piece discovered in an old wardrobe, ready to bring a little magic to every outfit. Pair with the Lumina Check Circle Skirt for a dreamy mix of lace, checks and ruffles.

azurite-collar-blouse.d: The Azurite Collar Blouse feels like a treasured find from a dressing-up box, with an embroidered removable collar and contrasting cuffs adding a playful sense of wonder. Finished with glimmering gold buttons, it brings a little celestial polish to everyday dressing. Pair with the Jasper Denim Jeans for a charming mix of romantic details and playful denim.

nephrite-taffeta-top.d: The Nephrite Taffeta Top feels like a jewel discovered beneath a velvet curtain, with its rich texture and sculptural asymmetric shape. Pleated detailing and a delicate bow trim bring a romantic flourish to this striking silhouette. Pair with the Rowan Barrel Leg Trousers for an evening-ready balance of soft enchantment and sharp tailoring.

eos-stripe-bow-blouse.d: A little everyday enchantment, the Eos Stripe Bow Blouse brings classic stripes to life with a statement necktie and glimmering pearlescent buttons edged in gold. Wear it loose and effortless for a look that feels as though it has wandered straight out of a storybook wardrobe. Pair with the Rowan Barrel Leg Trousers for a polished look with a little mystical mischief.

samantha-sequin-mini-skirt.d: A little sparkle never goes unnoticed. The Samantha Sequin Mini Skirt is covered in multicoloured sequins that catch the light with every step, finished with a contrasting trim for an extra dose of glamour. Sparkle extra bright by pairing with the Samantha Sequin Top . A head-to-toe sequin moment that will guarantee to turn heads at every party.

tyler-velvet-trousers.d: Luxurious texture meets effortless tailoring in the Tyler Velvet Trousers. Structured velvet, considered pleats and a relaxed silhouette make them an elevated alternative to everyday trousers, bringing rich texture and effortless sophistication to any look. Pair with the Dex Ruffle Stripe Shirt for a polished contrast of softness and structure, or style with the matching Tyler Velvet Blazer for a considered evening suit made for parties and special occasions.

colby-barrel-jeans.d: Forget ordinary denim. The Colby Barrel Jeans bring a little glamour to the everyday with all-over diamante embellishment, a sculptural barrel leg and considered seam detailing. Pair with the matching Colby Denim Shirt for a head-to-toe denim look with a sparkling twist or with a subtle black top or blouse and let the denim to all the talking. An outfit that will sparkle conversation at any festive occasion this party season.

neroli-trim-maxi-dress.d: Light as a warm coastal breeze, the Neroli Trim Maxi Dress drifts effortlessly from lazy mornings beneath olive trees to candlelit dinners overlooking the sea. elara-jacquard-mini-dress.d: The Elara Jacquard Mini Dress feels like wandering cobbled streets just before golden hour, with metallic florals glistening softly in the sun. sea-salt-jacquard-top.d: Inspired by salt-kissed afternoons along the shoreline, the Sea Salt Jacquard Top brings a playful charm to sunlit dressing. Its gathered ruffles and delicate florals pair beautifully the DREAM Sea Salt Jacquard Midi Skirt for dreamy harbour strolls.

juniper-stripe-sweetheart-maxi-dress.n: DREAM Juniper Stripe Sweetheart Maxi Dress

Its sweeping skirt and structured bodice bring timeless elegance to sunlit harbour dinners and moonlit strolls along cobbled streets.

marble-stripe-embellished-blouse.d: The Marble Stripe Embellished Blouse feels playful yet polished, with sparkling rose appliqués blooming across sun washed stripes. Style with the DREAM Thyme Cut Work Bubble Skirt , for twilight dinners beneath glowing lanterns.

thyme-cut-work-shirt.d: The Thyme Cut Work Shirt is made for slow mornings and salty breezes, blending delicate embroidery with an effortlessly relaxed silhouette. Style tucked into the DREAM Thyme Cut Work Bubble Skirt for the evening.

indigo-bloom-midi-dress.d: Bursting into bloom like wild island flowers after summer rain, the Indigo Bloom Midi Dress enchants with textured florals and satin ribbon ties. Made for magical evenings beneath a honey glow sunset, it feels both romantic and wonderfully whimsical.

neroli-trim-blouse.d: Softly floating with every movement, the Neroli Trim Blouse captures the beauty of warm island breezes and fragrant coastal gardens. Pair it with the DREAM Almond Embellished Jeans for dreamy lunches overlooking azure waters.

athena-floral-top.d: The Athena Floral Top blooms with romantic charm, crafted for sun filled adventures beneath endless skies. Its airy organza florals and delicate ties feel perfect for slow afternoons. Pair with the DREAM Almond Embellished Jeans for an effortless and breezy look.

athena-floral-midi-dress.d: The Athena Floral Midi Dress captures the romance of island evenings, with soft florals and delicate bows trailing beautifully down the open back. Wear it for dreamy dinners overlooking the ocean as the sky melts into shades of apricot and indigo.

honey-jacquard-mini-dress-2.d: Bathed in the warmth of a honey coloured sunset, the Honey Jacquard Mini Dress glows with understated romance. Its delicate tonal jacquard and soft silhouette make it perfect for balmy evenings wandering harbour towns beneath twinkling lights.

citrus-sequin-mini-dress.d: Bright and sparkling like citrus cocktails at golden hour, the Citrus Sequin Mini Dress is made for joyful island nights. Embroidered florals shimmer beautifully beneath lantern light, bringing playful glamour to seaside celebrations and sunset soirées. For an extra pop of colour, pair with the DREAM Terracotta Raffia Earrings .

terracotta-sweetheart-midi-dress.d: The Terracotta Sweetheart Midi Dress captures the warmth of sunset spilling across terracotta rooftops and winding coastal streets. Its full skirt moves beautifully with every breeze, making it the perfect piece for dinners beneath glowing skies. For a sunset moment, pair with the DREAM Terracotta Raffia Earrings .

lemon-zest-embellished-mini-dress.d: Bright as citrus served on a sun filled terrace, the Lemon Zest Embellished Mini Dress sparkles with playful island energy. The bead embellishments catch the afternoon light, making it your go-to for dancing barefoot by the marina.

milos-brooches-mini-dress.d: The Milos Brooches Mini Dress glimmers with ornate gold trims inspired by hidden treasures beneath the sea. Perfect for afternoons spent watching the sparkling ocean as the sun disappears into the horizon.

cleo-collar-tie-blouse.d: A playful nod to sailor styling, the Cleo Collar Tie Blouse feels made for breezy afternoons aboard a boat. Finished with a crochet collar and pearl buttons, it captures the innocence and nostalgia of island summers. Style with the Island Life Embroidered Jeans for a playful touch.

island-life-embroidered-top.d: Like a souvenir from an endless summer, the Island Life Embroidered Top is scattered with charming coastal motifs. Gem buttons add a touch of treasure, perfect for days spent exploring hidden coves. You’ve found your perfect treasure pair. Pair with the Island Life Embroidered Jeans .

island-life-embroidered-mini-dress.d: The Island Life Embroidered Mini Dress captures the carefree feeling of island adventures from sunrise to sunset. Embroidered motifs and gem buttons bring a sense of charm and discovery, perfect for wandering harbour towns with an ice cream in hand.

saffron-trim-mini-dress.d: Light as the summer breeze, the Saffron Trim Mini Dress is designed for sun soaked afternoons under olive trees. Broderie anglaise ruffles and delicate ties add a romantic softness inspired by island florals

tinos-stripe-mini-dress.d: The Tinos Stripe Mini Dress channels vintage sailor uniforms with a playful Sister Jane twist. Pearl buttons and textured stripes make it ideal for coastal café mornings and afternoons spent watching boats drift by. Sail away by pairing with the Sofia Sailor Hat .

orange-blossom-mini-dress.d: Sweet as citrus blossoms carried on the wind, the Orange Blossom Mini Dress captures the romance of island gardens in bloom. Puff sleeves and a bubble hem create a playful silhouette perfect for golden summer evenings. Pair with the Tinos Stripe Beaded Bag to carry all your discoveries.

about.sum:
The Brand
Sister Jane is an elevated London label with romance and nostalgia at heart.
Never the quiet one, we combine whimsical eccentricity with a distinctive style signature. Pieces emphasise unique, unexpected details that are colourful, fresh, and trend-led, while carrying a retro nod.
No day is the same: we aim to refresh your wardrobe by bringing you a new capsule collection every 6 weeks – making every piece a limited-edition gem.
And since you're here... Have you met our sister Ghospell?

We are aware of the impact that our industry can have on the environment, and the responsibility that we all share to operate in a sustainable way. We are working hard internally to make changes wherever possible to reduce our environmental footprint, and the impact our production has on the lives of others. As a result, we have highlighted priority areas where we can make the biggest difference - a starting point on our journey of sustainability.
In our assessment, production and waste are the areas where we can make a meaningful difference. We will begin our journey by looking at how we can improve our offering of the most eco-friendly fabrics as well as reducing any unnecessary waste.
Team work makes the dream work, so we want to involve our sisterhood in part of this journey by making information readily available and implementing an initiative to tackle wardrobe waste. Vast amounts of unwanted clothing are thrown away each year, most of which end up in landfills instead of reaching communities that would benefit from donations. This is something we are keen to address but need a little help from our sisters!
